common.tagline: AI-Powered Customer Communication Automation for Local Businesses & Marketplaces

landing.heroTitle: Customers use different channels. Your team works in one inbox.
landing.heroSubtitle: Bring website, Telegram, WhatsApp, Viber and Instagram inquiries into one inbox. AI uses your business knowledge, your team handles exceptions, and recorded sales reveal each channel’s results.
landing.trustedBy: Designed for local businesses and online sellers
landing.calculatorSubtitle: Calculate how much revenue your business leaves on the table each month due to delayed messaging responses
landing.calcLostRateLabel: Lost to faster competitors (>10 min wait): ~35%
landing.featuresSubtitle: Connect your business accounts using official APIs. Channel availability depends on the platform’s permissions and account requirements.
landing.feat1Desc: Website widget and connected messengers. Every conversation keeps its source and replies return to that channel.
landing.feat2Desc: Use verified services, prices, product details and business rules to prepare AI replies.
landing.feat3Desc: Assign an owner, add internal notes and record the next step. Human takeover stops AI replies.
landing.feat4Desc: Record sales and channel spend, compare conversion, sales value and recorded profit. Currencies stay separate.
landing.pricingTitle: Find the right setup for your team
landing.pricingSubtitle: Discuss channels, inquiry volume and AI limits. Stripe shows the configured subscription price before payment. External platforms have their own account and pricing requirements.
landing.planStartDesc: For individual repair shops, beauty salons, clinics, and solo practitioners
landing.planStartF1: Website chat widget and direct link
landing.planProDesc: For growing businesses, marketplace sellers, and marketing agencies
landing.planProF2: AI budget and usage limits by agreement
landing.planEnterpriseDesc: For retail chains, large Amazon/Shopify brands, and multi-location franchises
landing.planEnterpriseF1: Channel and usage limits by agreement
landing.planEnterpriseF4: Deployment and data requirements reviewed individually
landing.modalSubtitle: Leave your contact details to discuss the pilot. No payment is taken.
landing.modalSuccessDesc: Your contact details have been saved for the project owner to review. Automatic email confirmations are not enabled yet.
landing.demoCustomerMsg: “Hello! How much is a BMW F30 diagnostic inspection and can I book for today after 6:00 PM?”
landing.demoAiMsg: “Hello! In this example, diagnostics costs 500 ₴. Please tell us your car model; an operator will confirm availability.”
landing.audiencesTitle: For teams that need every inquiry in view
landing.audiencesSubtitle: Start with the channels your customers already use.
landing.audLocalDesc: Auto repair, medical clinics, beauty salons, home services
landing.audLocalPain: Slow replies can leave customer questions unanswered.
landing.audLocalSolution: Goal: help answer common questions and collect booking requests.
landing.audMarketplacesPain: Customers need clear answers about product details.
landing.audMarketplacesSolution: Goal: use verified product facts in supported channels.
landing.audMarketplacesChannels: Store website and messengers; marketplace APIs are not connected
landing.audAgenciesPain: Pain: Paid ad traffic is wasted by slow or untrained sales reps.
landing.audAgenciesSolution: Goal: separate workspaces for each client business.
landing.calcFact: Illustration, not a forecast. Assumptions: 35% recovery factor, 40 UAH/USD and a $49 subscription. Costs and margin are excluded.
landing.footerCopy: © 2026 ReplyLocal · One inbox for customer conversations

omni.channelsIntro: All conversations reach the same inbox. Replies go back to the customer’s channel.
omni.label: Connection name
omni.appSecret: Meta App Secret (blank uses server setting)
omni.accountId: Phone Number ID / Instagram User ID
omni.providerSetup: Telegram and Viber install the webhook when enabled. For WhatsApp and Instagram, configure the URL and verify token in Meta, subscribe to the messaging events and account, then enable. Third-party accounts require messaging permissions and applicable app review.
omni.channelLimits: Text conversations. Attachments are flagged for an operator; open the file in the original channel. WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram Business replies use the 24-hour customer reply window. Identities across channels are kept separate.
omni.profitHint: Optional: sale value minus your direct costs. Leave blank if unknown.
omni.noteHint: Only your team sees these notes. They are not sent to the customer or AI.
omni.retryConfirm: Retrying can duplicate a message if the provider already accepted it. Send again?
omni.reportHint: Cohort: conversations created in the selected UTC month and their current outcomes. Sales are recorded by your team. Currencies stay separate; profit covers only sales with a recorded profit.
omni.costHint: Enter actual monthly advertising and channel fees. Saving replaces the previous amount.
omni.noData: No data for this month yet.
omni.emailQueued: Email queued. Check integrations for delivery failures.
omni.emailNotSent: Email was not sent because email delivery is not configured. Share the link yourself.
omni.notifications: Email when an operator is needed
omni.notificationHint: Sent to the assignee, otherwise owners and admins. Notifications for the same conversation are grouped within five-minute intervals.
omni.queueHint: Pending tasks and failures appear here. Configure the scheduled worker described in the setup guide for crash recovery.
omni.manualBilling: Billing is currently manual. The service owner must configure Stripe, a price and the webhook to enable subscriptions.
omni.billingHint: Stripe shows the price and billing interval before confirmation. Subscription status updates through the verified webhook.
omni.joinHint: Sign in or create an account using the invited email, then accept the invitation.
omni.name: Your name
omni.resetSent: If the account exists, a reset link has been sent to its email.
omni.error: The action failed. Refresh the data and check your settings.
omni.CONFLICT: Data changed. Refresh and try again.
omni.ENCRYPTION_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server channel encryption key is missing.
omni.CHANNEL_ALREADY_CONNECTED: This channel account is already connected.
omni.INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: Sign in with the invited email address.
omni.INVITE_EXPIRED: The invitation is invalid or expired.
omni.RESET_EXPIRED: The reset link is invalid or expired.
omni.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot perform this action.
omni.REPLY_WINDOW_CLOSED: The 24-hour window closed. Wait for a new customer message or use a permitted method in the original channel.
omni.NETWORK_UNCERTAIN: The provider did not confirm delivery. Check the original chat before retrying.
omni.ACCOUNT_EXISTS: An account with this email exists. Sign in and accept the invitation.
omni.SUBSCRIPTION_EXISTS: A subscription exists. Open billing management.
omni.NOT_FOUND: The record was not found or is not accessible.
omni.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Check the token and business account permissions.
omni.ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: The account ID does not match the token.
omni.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a team member.

omni.AI_PILOT_CAP: The plan allowance and server-wide budget also limit daily AI attempts.
omni.META_APP_NOT_CONFIGURED: Enter the app secret or configure META_APP_SECRET on the server.
